title: Norml WordPress Architecture
audience: WordPress developers, architects and project owners
pitch: Choose the WordPress content model, routes and registration ownership before implementation.
problem: A repeatable collection built as separate Pages loses automatic archives, filters and a reusable layout.
The package distinguishes content identity, classification, structured attributes and presentation before a builder creates the wrong primitive.
commands: Should this be a custom post type or a page
Plan the case-study archive and single URLs
Audit the inherited WordPress content model
Map this model to Elementor or Sage

flow.d: Read existing types, taxonomies and ownership.
Choose primitives, classification and typed fields.
Specify archive/single URLs and template slots.
Record registration ownership and rendering spec.

items.name: Model decisions
items.desc: Pages/posts/CPTs, taxonomy versus attributes and options.

items.name: URL/template planning
items.desc: Route bases, collisions, hierarchy and rewrite flush.

items.name: Write production theme code
items.desc: Outputs a specification, then the build workflow implements it.

items.role: Named nouns and three fast decision trees

items: Does not implement templates, register live types or migrate content.
Existing registrations and knowing user overrides must be respected.
ACF/storage behavior must be verified instead of assuming theme-switch outcomes.
